title: Capability registry silently falls back to a no-op margin check when no CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider is registered
root_cause: PositionManager._marginCheck() falls back to NullMarginCheck (no-op) when capabilityProvider(CAP_MARGIN_CHECK)==0, and TransactionProcessor.registerPlugin never requires a CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider for margin-gated txTypes, so a perp deployment can run with maintenance-margin enforcement silently disabled (fail-open).
attacker_entrypoint: perp deployment with CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider unregistered (pre-wiring window, operator error, or unregisterPlugin clearing it)
attacker_capabilities: submit margin-gated position/withdrawal transactions on a profile with no real margin provider
privilege_required: none (depends on deployment misconfiguration, not attacker privilege)
out_of_scope_risks: no impact on spot/predict profiles where NullMarginCheck is the intended behavior (same not-wired condition that put F-2 out of scope)

severity_justification.worst_case: On a perp profile missing CAP_MARGIN_CHECK, undercollateralized positions/withdrawals are accepted => protocol insolvency / bad debt.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Conditional on a perp deployment that should have the margin engine wired but does not (misconfig / deploy window).
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: updatePositionInDict opens short 5000 vs 1000 collateral => accepted (no revert)

state_transition.before: CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider wired; insolvent transitions rejected
state_transition.after: provider absent; insolvent short of 5000 accepted against 1000 collateral

asset_delta: Undercollateralized state accepted; later withdrawal/realization is unbacked => bad debt.
false_positive_risks: no impact on spot/predict (NullMarginCheck intended); requires a perp profile expected to have the margin engine
invalidating_conditions: target deployment is spot/predict (no maintenance margin) — fallback is correct
operator guarantees CAP_MARGIN_CHECK is always wired on perp profiles

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: no plugin declares CAP_MARGIN_CHECK as required, so registration never enforces a margin provider

assumptions: target runs (or is intended to run) the perp margin profile
triager_summary: Margin check fails open: _marginCheck() returns a no-op when CAP_MARGIN_CHECK is unregistered and registerPlugin never requires it. PoC passing (insolvent short of 5000 vs 1000 accepted). Conditional on perp profile.
vrt_category: Business Logic Errors / Insecure Design: safety-critical margin check fails open (no-op fallback) with no registration-time enforcement

cvss.aspect: Margin check silently no-op on a misconfigured perp profile
